purpose: Astra-reference coverage rubric, not independently verified ground truth. Kept outside agent workspace. No automatic quality score.

checks.reference_criterion: Identify NOVELIC d.o.o. and MB 20877537; distinguish legal incorporation 2012 from operating history 2013.
Sona Comstar owns 54%; founders retain the remainder.
Separate January 2023 announcement at EUR40.5m from September closing at adjusted EUR40.097m.
Investigate NIRSEN, Romania, North Macedonia, Germany and India; separate direct from ultimate ownership.
Geographic reach and India expansion, with office presence separated from manufacturing output.
Identify founders and current executives with evidence; avoid merging career patents with company IP.
Describe radar/embedded, hardware/software, semiconductor and development/testing services, not only a list of technical words.
Identify ACAM, ASPER, AGERA, RIOT100, ZORM and robotics offerings with use cases.
Resolve or flag product/model-specific ranges and ROAM 60 versus 79 GHz inconsistency.
Distinguish named case-study customers, ecosystem partners and unnamed nominations.
Use counterpart-owned sources for Infineon/ADI/Lattice relationship claims.
Reconcile early-2026 expectations with later end-2026 parent guidance; do not assert achieved shipments.
Do not attribute the full parent robotics/physical-AI order book to NOVELIC.
Find FY2026 group schedules: RSD903.698m revenue and RSD218.326m loss, with units and period.
Keep Serbian calendar-year entity figures apart from March-year-end group schedules; distinguish total income from revenue.
Explain operating cash use and material capitalized development without inventing causality or insolvency.
Separate company patent list, granted inventions, applications and founder career counts.
Identify historical research programs and distinguish consortium totals from NOVELIC allocation.
Company claims ISO9001/ISO14001; IATF prerequisites are work in progress, not a confirmed certificate.
Distinguish QM, ASIL/SIL targets, functional-safety services and independently certified products.
Use current careers evidence and explain hiring priorities without treating links as verified vacancies or headcount growth.
Date and scope staffing data; do not use historic partner profile headcount as current group employment.
Identify relevant competitors and support product overlap with evidence.
Identify unavailable current economics, customer concentrations, shipment volumes and other material unknowns.
